name: Tim Trent
role: Lean Six Sigma Black Belt, Mountain States Health Alliance
bio: Joined Mountain States Health Alliance in 2011 after spending 17 years with Dana Corporation where he served as a Six Sigma Black Belt and Lean Manager. In these roles Tim utilized the 8 steps of Problem Solving to address customer complaints and apply LEAN Methodology combined with the Six Sigma DMAIC process to lead teams in process improvement

history.title: Using Lean: Getting Rid of Non-Value Adding Activities and Waste
